subject: geography

items.why: The answer examiners want is: McLean. “Bezos” is the distractor this question was built around — if it tempted you, that's the exact gap to close.

items.q: What does the KOF Index measure?
items.why: It's Globalisation. “Poverty” is the classic near-miss here; knowing why it's wrong is worth as much as knowing the right answer.

items.q: Top 500 TNCs control roughly what percentage of trade?
items.why: Exact answer: 70 %. Estimation gets you near it; only the anchored number survives the exam hall.
